exposure: Gestational age at PROM (preterm vs. term)
cohort: 61 cases of PROM managed at Ladoke Akintola University of Technology Teaching Hospital (LTH), Ogbomoso, Nigeria over a 3-year period
finding: The incidence of PROM at term was high, and conservative/expectant management was effective.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the intervention instituted (p=0.009).
